tasks.label: build: docker image
tasks.command: if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc ] || [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl ]; then mkdir -p dist; echo "mcp-context-manager executables are missing; building glibc and musl binaries..." >&2; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-slim sh -c 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils build-essential libffi-dev libssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-alpine sh -c 'apk add --no-cache binutils build-base musl-dev libffi-dev openssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; fi; docker build --build-arg SERVER_BINARY=dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl -t mcp-context-manager:local .

tasks.label: build: standalone executable
tasks.command: mkdir -p dist && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-slim sh -c 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils build-essential libffi-dev libssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist' && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-alpine sh -c 'apk add --no-cache binutils build-base musl-dev libffi-dev openssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'

tasks.label: build: docker image tar.gz
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p dist; if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc ] || [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl ]; then echo "mcp-context-manager executables are missing; building glibc and musl binaries..." >&2; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-slim sh -c 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends binutils build-essential libffi-dev libssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/workspace" -w /workspace python:3.12-alpine sh -c 'apk add --no-cache binutils build-base musl-dev libffi-dev openssl-dev && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install pyinstaller . && pyinstaller --onefile --name mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl --distpath /workspace/dist --collect-all mcp_context_manager src/mcp_context_manager/__main__.py; chown -R "$(stat -c "%u:%g" /workspace)" /workspace/dist'; fi; docker build --build-arg SERVER_BINARY=dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl -t mcp-context-manager:local .; docker save mcp-context-manager:local | gzip -9 > dist/mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz

tasks.label: build: local release artifacts
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc ] || [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl ]; then echo 'mcp-context-manager standalone binaries are missing; run the standalone build task first.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -x dist/mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz ]; then echo 'dist/mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz is missing; run the docker image tar.gz task first.' >&2; exit 1; fi; (cd dist && sha256sum mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-glibc mcp-context-manager-linux-x86_64-musl mcp-context-manager-local-image.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS)
